pois.name: Volcanic rim slope (pre-2022 survey)
pois.note: The terrain grid reads about 468.6 m here, deeper than Hunga’s pre-eruption central basin (150–200 m). This is a volcanic slope beyond the basin, not a surveyed inner caldera wall. The authored tuff scarp shares this marker location and is explicitly a game addition.

pois.name: Volcanic flank transect (pre-2022 survey)
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain: 292.9 m deep at the centre of row 306, column 267 (zero-based) in data/tiles/hunga-tonga-caldera/heightmap.bin. This terrain survey is about 660 m east-northeast of the volcanic rim-slope scan. The pre-2022 GMRT grid reads about 293 m here, compared with about 469 m at the rim-slope point. The nearby pair samples the volcanic flank beyond the shallow central basin. This point was chosen from the survey grid for the dive; it is not a separately named volcanic feature. Continue east to the optional shallow basin-floor scan to compare that earlier landscape. No prop or staged encounter is added.

pois.name: Caldera floor (pre-2022 survey)
pois.note: Real survey terrain, this tile's own reading: 131.6 m deep here, closely matching the widely cited pre-eruption caldera-floor depth of ~150 m (NIWA). This tile predates the 15 January 2022 eruption (see mission.json/guide.json); nothing about the post-eruption caldera is shown at this point.
